yt_title: Day 2 of 10 — The Night Before | Anaya's Ten Days EP09
short:
Two days left.

Everything ready and lined up by the door. The card on top, so it wouldn't get crushed.

At eleven the storm came in off the fields.
She thought about the train. Whether trains stop for storms.
cta:
Then the phone rang. At midnight, nobody calls with good news 🧡
EP10 tomorrow — the finale ✦
